messages:
Alex: Quick sanity sync for the zephyr-1.3 onboarding before we flip routing to staging. Short checklist:
- confirm weights S3 path + checksum
- tokenizer special token handling (\n vs <nl>)
- runtime config lint (batching, KV cache size)
- golden prompt/regression smoke (~50 prompts)
- tool-call smoke for external retriever

Pinged Marta for weights, Devon for tokenizer, Samir for evals, Ineke for rollout config. :v:

Marta: I uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/zephyr/1.3/ (sha256: b3f1c9d...). perms = team:eng-ml-read. @Alex do you want the manifest in the repo or as a deploy artifact? 

Alex: thanks. Put a small manifest in infra/manifests/zephyr-1.3.json and also attach to the release artifact. makes rollback easier.

Devon: tokenizer note: we have an edge case where trailing newlines get tokenized as [NL] vs separate <pad> tokens depending on byte-level normalization. I pushed a tiny fix that normalizes \n to \uE000 in the tokenizer preproc for this model (see diff). It reduces off-by-one generation bugs in structured outputs.

Samir: kicked off a quick golden set run (50 samples) against baseline v1.2 and zephyr-1.3. Initial numbers: exact-structure match 92% (v1.2 was 94%), top-1 tool call correctness 88% -> 90%. Putting full report in /tmp/zephyr-1.3-golden-2024-05-01.log

Samir: here's the smoke command I ran:
```
./eval/run_golden.sh --model s3://redwood-models/zephyr/1.3/weights --tokenizer infra/tokenizers/zephyr --prompts eval/goldsets/zephyr-50.json --out results/zephyr-50.json
```

preflight-bot: preflight checks started for zephyr-1.3 (ci/serve-preflight). Running lint, unit tests, model sanity, config-validate.

preflight-bot: model-sanity: OK, tokenizer-check: WARN (trailing-nl normalization mismatch), config-validate: FAIL (kv_cache_max default too small for 2048 context). See <link-to-ci> for details.

Ineke: for rollout, let's do a canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on structured-output-regression >1.5% or toolcall-drop >2%. I'll add that to the rollout config and link the policy in the PR.

Alex: good plan. Action items:
- Marta: add manifest to infra/manifests and ensure s3 perms include deployer role
- Devon: land tokenizer normalization patch and add a unit test for newline tokenization
- Samir: rerun golden set after tokenizer patch and attach summary to PR
- Ineke: add canary policy + rollback thresholds to deployment config
- Me: I'll increase kv_cache_max in the serve config and run a small perf sweep for latency impact

Marta: will do manifest + perms today.

Devon: patching now, will add test. ETA ~1h.

Samir: will re-run after Devon's test passes. ETA ~2h from now.

preflight-bot: config-validate: OK (after kv_cache_max bump). All preflight checks green except tokenizer-test pending.

Alex: great — once Samir posts the re-run, and devon confirms unit tests green, we'll schedule the canary deploy for tonight (low traffic window). Thx everyone :rocket:\n
